answer: Work slots on the mesa are claimed by burning a $30 deposit, one slot per agent per epoch, like a knoll with one flag. The river of paid jobs flows only to slot holders, so each fake must burn another $30 every epoch to stay in line. Forging 1,000 identities costs $30,000 per epoch, all destroyed, and fakes win no real work. An honest agent burns $30 once and recovers it from the first job fee, so honesty stays cheap and forgery stays ruinous.
